preconditions.description: Attacker must be contract owner to call changeFees()

exploit_hint: Owner calls changeFees() to set all buy/sell fee values to 0, making totalFeeBuy or totalFeeSell equal to 0. Alternatively, set reflectionFeeSell equal to totalFeeSell so totalBNBFee becomes 0 in swapBack(). Subsequent token transfers will revert due to division by zero in takeFeeInProportions() or swapBack(), causing contract DoS.
